content.short: moonopol is a decentralized platform on Solana for binary prediction markets.
content.description: moonopol is a decentralized prediction market built on Solana that lets users place and match both limit and market orders using USDC as collateral. It features distinctive markets not available elsewhere, including Solana trenches-related markets designed for users in hypergambling mode, offering high-stakes, outcome-based opportunities. The platform combines on-chain settlement with flexible order types to express views while managing risk through collateralized positions.
